scope: UX183 broadcast recipient count, preparation and explicit send flow

cause.description: In the active compact audience profile the confirmation count used preview.eligibleCount and defaulted to zero before preparation. A selected contact did not constitute a preview; the independent acknowledgement checkbox could be ticked before the preview, while the final button also required the preview. The UI showed a selected recipient beside a confirmation for zero and gave no clear preparation/send progression.

proof.confirmationLabel: Je confirme le contenu et l’envoi individuel à 0 client.

behavior: Selection count changes immediately (1, 2, remove back to 1), while only server preview results are described as eligible/prepared.
Two explicit actions: Check and prepare to send, then Send to N clients. The redundant acknowledgement checkbox is removed. Preparation never creates a campaign.
The final send action acknowledges the prepared snapshot internally before the existing campaign guard. It does not bypass composition, session, recipient eligibility or repeated attachment consent.
Title, body, attachment, selection, audience and filter edits invalidate preparation and its generation. Late results for an earlier generation are rejected.
Suspending an unsubmitted draft preserves text/selection/attachments but requires a fresh preparation after owner revalidation.
Uncertain campaigns retain the same frozen payload and identifier; only the explicit retry uses them. Existing de-duplication and retry contracts are preserved.
French and English labels and live selected/prepared counts are covered.
